CardDescription.DefaultText:
A large and ancient boulder.
Its surface seems to hold the suggestion of a face, though it shifts when you try to focus on it.
CardDescription.Text: 一块古老的巨石。\n它的表面似乎有一张模糊的脸，会在你专注于它的时候产生变化。
CardDescription.zh: 一块古老的巨石。\n它的表面似乎有一张模糊的脸，会在你专注于它的时候产生变化。
CardDescription.en: A large and ancient boulder.\nIts surface seems to hold the suggestion of a face, though it shifts when you try to focus on it.
CardDescription.ja: 巨大で太古から存在する巨石。\n表面には顔のようなものが浮かんで見えるが、意識して見ると形が揺らぐ。
